objectives.description: Identify and safely use fashion tools and equipment including needles, scissors, tape measure, thimble, and sewing machine
Identify types of fabrics, their properties, and appropriate uses in garment making
Demonstrate basic hand stitches (running stitch, backstitch, hemming, oversewing) with correct technique
Describe types and uses of seams and apply them in joining fabric pieces
Describe garment care practices including correct washing, ironing, and storage of different fabric types
Take and record accurate body measurements for garment making using a tape measure
Draft simple flat patterns for basic garments (blouse, skirt, shorts, shirt) using measurements
Cut fabric accurately along pattern markings with appropriate seam allowances
Create basic fashion illustrations and sketches for simple garment designs
Describe Nigerian traditional fabrics (Ankara, Adire, Aso-oke) and their cultural significance
Construct simple garments including a blouse, shirt, skirt, or shorts following given patterns and instructions
Apply dressmaking techniques including tucks, darts, gathering, and pleats in garment construction
Sew a simple traditional Nigerian garment or ceremonial outfit applying appropriate techniques
Describe fashion accessories (beads, head ties, belts, bags) and their role in completing an outfit
Design and create a complete school uniform applying all construction skills learned
Identify career paths in fashion including tailor, fashion designer, textile artist, and stylist
Describe the steps involved in starting a small-scale fashion business including sourcing, pricing, and marketing
Write a simple business plan for a small fashion enterprise
Explain the global relevance of Nigerian fashion and the export potential of Nigerian fabrics (Ankara, Adire, Aso-oke)
Organise and present garments in a school fashion show or exhibition demonstrating design and craftsmanship
